message:
Now I see the fuzz targets. The `spoolss` interface with `TYPE_IN` and function 65 is fuzzed. Let me look at the spoolss IDL to understand what function 65 is and how it uses `to_null` charset arrays. Let me also check what's built and available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/samba/bin/ 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/samba/ | head -30; echo "---"; find /workspace -name "fuzz_ndr*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
